scope: Independent offline review of the three requested hardening areas, including two additional regressions fixed during review. No external reads/writes, installs or platform actions.

tests.realBrowserRedirectCountercheck: PASS: pre-fix local redirect target was fetched without guard; final real route.fetch(max_redirects=0) aborted 302 after only the initial loopback GET.

verifiedCorrections.result: Both browser extraction paths scope price nodes under product-information-details and exact product-id, exclude cards/recommendations, and evaluator requires corresponding ancestry flags. Actual static DOM tested missing main with same-ID recommendations outside and inside details, plus valid main with a wrong same-ID card.

Whole-string match, consistent single grouping separator, exactly two fractional digits or none, Decimal conversion without quantization. Suffix/multiple-value/third-decimal/repeated-separator false-PASS examples now reject.

urllib validates every resolved Location before constructing follow-up request. Browser initial URL is validated and every 3xx is rejected after route.fetch(max_redirects=0), without route.continue_. Safe responses are fulfilled. Production call site invokes guarded_browser_route.

limitations: No live storefront QA and no PASS assertion for any product or current displayed price.
Static DOM tests use the actual browser_snapshot extraction and a known fixture variant id; live variant-changing controls were not exercised.

Real browser redirect test only contacted loopback. Its URL validator was temporarily replaced in memory to permit the exact local HTTP fixture; production HTTPS/host validation is checked by unit tests and code review.
All browser 3xx responses, including legitimate shop redirects, are now deliberately aborted. Such responses can cause bounded QA to fail or become unavailable rather than a false PASS.
No repository/platform write, workflow, deployment or full catalogue assessment.
